description: Clinical dictation, hypertensive urgency. The recorded ASR output is SYNTHETIC and carries two deliberately injected error classes, both of which real Whisper models produce constantly on clinical dictation: spoken numbers emitted as numerals ('one hundred eighty' -> '180', 'one hundred ten' -> '110') and a drug-route term abbreviated ('intravenous' -> 'IV'). Nothing here came from a live model. The point is that this transcript is arguably PERFECT for a human reader and still scores a substantial WER, because WER measures transcription rather than comprehension -- see the note in services/wer.py about why numerals are deliberately not normalized away.
text: Blood pressure is 180 over 110 with persistent occipital headache. Evaluate for hypertensive urgency and perform fundoscopy before initiating IV antihypertensive therapy.
reference_transcript: Blood pressure is one hundred eighty over one hundred ten with persistent occipital headache. Evaluate for hypertensive urgency and perform fundoscopy before initiating intravenous antihypertensive therapy.
